title: crataegus rotundifolia var. chrysocarpa
intro: Crataegus rotundifolia var. chrysocarpa, commonly known as the Golden Hawthorn, is a variety of the hawthorn plant, which is a type of flowering shrub or small tree. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of blood pressure, improvement of cardiovascular health, and lowering of cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Golden Hawthorn are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins, and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Golden Hawthorn are believed to contribute to its potential therapeutic effects, including its ability to improve cardiovascular health and reduce the risk of heart disease.
